text: The factory reports a merge as its own from the merge record it writes before merging only when GitHub's merged_by doesn't name someone other than its own login (#756). A watcher can stop between recording a merge and making it; a person who then merged that head had the merge reported as the factory's and its branch deleted. With no login of its own, as in legacy token mode, or no merged_by from GitHub, the record stands as before. Found by a search of Invariant's implicit state machines; built by hand at @gitdek's request.
